public_sources.title: Finite Padé and orthogonality
public_sources.scope: Context for formal orthogonality; the finite error identity is derived directly. Positivity is not imported.

public_sources.title: Skein Modules and the Noncommutative Torus
public_sources.scope: Context for torus skein product-to-sum; only elementary classical commuting SL2 trace identities are used.

public_sources.title: A Determinantal Formula for Supersymmetric Schur Polynomials
public_sources.scope: Rectangular Berele-Regev factorization and polynomial Jacobi-Trudi form. No divided alternant is inverted at a hit.

public_sources.title: Algebraic/combinatorial proofs of Cayley-type identities for derivatives of determinants and pfaffians
public_sources.scope: Appendix A.5 Gaussian determinant identity; native finite product is derived without factorial divisions.

public_sources.title: On the Ihara expression for the generalized weighted zeta function
public_sources.scope: Weighted edge-to-vertex determinant reduction. The needed cleared finite identity is also proved directly; no analytic cycle product or Q-algebra theorem is blindly specialized.

public_sources.title: Free Fermionic Schur Functions
public_sources.scope: Supersymmetric/free-fermionic Cauchy and Yang-Baxter context. The finite dual-Cauchy polynomial identity is used, not a free transfer contraction.

public_sources.title: Fast in-place accumulation
public_sources.scope: Fast accumulation and modular remainder contracts require an acquired numerator. Does not generate the implicit geometric factorial.

public_sources.title: Fast Computation of the N-th Term of a q-Holonomic Sequence and Applications
public_sources.scope: Existing q-factorial baby/giant context; no new degree-independent full-family bound inferred.

scope: Literature context and exact finite derivations. Not all listed formulae are new. No external theorem supplies the missing soft-K acquisition.
